novelty_flags.label: Literature map and all sequential-average-case flagship statements
novelty_flags.one_line: Add JinRenZhou2026FSensitivity, which develops an average-impact f-divergence sensitivity model with sharp DRO duality and inference; distinguish its cross-sectional f-ball from the proposed sequential transported quadratic perspective rather than treating Zhang--Zhao as the sole close average-case comparator.

soundness_flags.label: ass:root-neighborhood-differentiability and ass:root-derivative-modulus
soundness_flags.one_line: The nuisance-indexed operator \(\mathcal F^{\widetilde\beta}\) is never constructed: the core does not specify which entries of the heterogeneous \(\widetilde\beta\) replace which arguments of \(\mathcal F\), so its Frechet derivative and uniform modulus are not determinate objects.

soundness_flags.label: ass:root-derivative-modulus
soundness_flags.one_line: Its condition quantifies over \(\mathcal B_\beta(\delta)\), but the only declared localized set is \(\mathcal B_\beta^+(\delta)\); use one declared positivity-preserving domain consistently.

soundness_flags.label: ass:score-bounded
soundness_flags.one_line: Bounded \(Y\), overlap, compact root ranges, and the positive-price bounds already uniformly bound every displayed component of \(\Psi_s\); retain this as a derived lemma rather than an additional standard assumption.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 5 (full-ray breakdown)
soundness_flags.one_line: Once the regular-ray simultaneous band is granted, membership of \(g_P\) in the class defining \(C_b\) and hence \(\kappa_b^\star\in C_b\) is exactly the containment observation built into def:full-ray-inversion; demote it to a corollary or add a non-definitional statistical contribution.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 4 and Theorem 5
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform Gaussian inference and its ray consequence are conditional on a positive resolution of Open-ended Question 1; no optimizer-stability or quadratic remainder is currently assumed proved.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The endpoint band is a conditional consequence of the root-stability/orthogonality result, and full-ray coverage is conditional on that band.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Population local price analysis
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The population price root is assumed to exist and lie in a uniformly interior positive-price neighborhood; only local uniqueness and stability under nuisance perturbation are targeted.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All root-stability claims are local, interior-price claims over the stated regular budget region \(S\), not global invertibility claims.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies longitudinal time-varying treatments, introduces primary, joint, and product sensitivity models, and gives observed-data convex-optimization representations of sharp and conservative population bounds.

The article introduces a cross-sectional second-moment propensity-ratio sensitivity model, derives sharp bounds and efficient one-step estimators, and constructs multiplier-bootstrap simultaneous sensitivity-curve bands.
The paper permits discrete or continuous, static or time-varying treatments and develops efficient estimators and confidence intervals for three distinct MSM sensitivity models.

The article establishes the DML framework based on Neyman-orthogonal scores and cross-fitting for root-n inference with estimated nuisance functions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Jin, Ren, and Zhou's f-sensitivity model to the bibliography and prove an explicit separation or nesting result between its expected f-divergence ball, Zhang--Zhao's cross-sectional quadratic model, and the proposed transported sequential perspective class.

Define \(\mathcal F^{\widetilde\beta}\) component by component, state the exact perturbable nuisance subvector, and derive score boundedness from the primitive boundedness, overlap, root-range, and price assumptions.

Move deterministic full-ray inversion to a corollary and replace its theorem slot with a genuinely statistical nonregular contribution, such as a sharp local-face limit or an explicit valid construction under an estimated regular-region boundary.

recommended_next_step: Revise this angle by repairing the perturbed-root operator, removing the redundant score-bound assumption, demoting deterministic inversion, and adding the missing f-sensitivity comparator before Stage 0.
